title: Functional unlabeled Ziplock bag organizer for wall or drawer; no hardware included
text:
Functional unlabeled Ziplock bag organizer for wall or drawer; no hardware included. This is a functional four-compartment organizer to store different types of Ziplock bags (quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack). The unit faceplate is very thin and the center hole is tinier than the others as I assume it is for snack bags but the narrow opening makes it hard to remove the bags. It does come with labels that can be affixed to the compartments.

It does not come with the mounting screws and plastic mollies needed to hang this on a wall. If putting this in a drawer, it would have been great to also come with rubberized feet for the bottom to prevent scratches or prevent it from sliding around.

The faceplate slides out on the side so that it can be loaded but I find it easy to load through the holes unless I have a full box of bags.

Note that when this is on the wall, the bags can fall out when loading, so it is important to only slide the cover out halfway.

Overall, this is a good organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. It is definitely a decent unit. The current price of $19.99 is competitively priced for this especially since this is a lower quality unit compared to other organizers I tried. However, it is still very functional.

There are many other Ziplock bag organizer options available on the market such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]] or an individual heavy plastic set like [[ASIN:B09THNTBGX this]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.
